about: Curated Arabic + Latin font pairs (Addendum M M2-T4, draft). Classes are the curator's (draft, pending the brand-systems-designer verdict on the specimen sheet, H29); every other number is measured by engine/reel/lib/font_pairing.py from the font files and is rebuilt by its build command. Rows: band auto (>= 70) may be used automatically, shown (50-69) goes to the editor with the reason, refused (< 50) is never used. latin_scale puts the Latin x-height on the Arabic letter body. licence: nameID 13/14 of the face, sha256 of the family's OFL.txt and of the font file. Families with origin external were measured from a folder outside the repo (the pinned font source of setup/components.json) and are kept as measured when the table is rebuilt without it.

Alexandria.note: geometric Kufi-sans with its own Latin

Amiri.note: classical Naskh with its own Latin

Cairo.note: geometric Kufi-sans with its own Latin

IBM Plex Sans Arabic.note: humanist Naskh-sans with its own Latin

Inter.note: neo-grotesque sans: nearest spec class humanist

Markazi Text.note: Naskh text face with its own Latin

Readex Pro.note: geometric sans with its own Latin

Syne.note: display sans (one bold file in the repo)

Tajawal.note: geometric sans with its own Latin
